package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 lint "zabaplint"
)
type query struct{Type,Name string}
type update struct{Filename string;Raw *string}
type step struct{Label string;Updates []update;Queries []query;After []update}
type manifest struct{Files []lint.File;Config string;Queries []query;Steps []step}
func main(){
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var input manifest;if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&input);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var c lint.Checker;c.Prime(input.Files,nil,input.Config)
 encoder:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
 dump:=func(label string,queries []query){for _,q:=range queries{
  issues,found:=c.CheckObject(q.Type,q.Name);files,treeFound:=c.Tree(q.Type,q.Name);if treeFound!=found{panic("existence differs")}
  if err:=encoder.Encode(struct{Label,Type,Name string;Found bool;Issues []lint.Issue;Files []lint.FileTree}{label,q.Type,q.Name,found,issues,files});err!=nil{panic(err)}
 }}
 dump("baseline",input.Queries)
 for _,s:=range input.Steps{for _,u:=range s.Updates{c.Update(u.Filename,u.Raw)};dump(s.Label,s.Queries);if len(s.After)>0{for _,u:=range s.After{c.Update(u.Filename,u.Raw)};dump(s.Label+"-restored",s.Queries)}}
}
